correctness.rationale: The distinct-word fiber and counting formulas hold. At each length, sliding windows realize every one-count between the extrema. Extension and shortening show that the extrema are equivalent to shortest lengths reaching specified one-count lower bounds and longest lengths respecting upper bounds. The relevant shortest lengths min(b,c)+2 and b+c+3 determine the unordered inner pair; n−1−min(a,d) and the outer-gap sum determine the unordered outer pair. Among the two nonreversed orders with both pairs unequal, write A>α for the outer gaps and B>β for the inner gaps. The only possibly differing maximum is the longest factor with at most one one: minus one, the two maxima are max(A+B,B+β) and max(A+β,α+B,B+β). They coincide iff β≥A. Equal pairs already collapse the candidate list to the reversal orbit; the conditional formula is correct as a set of distinct words, not an unqualified iff for membership of an inner-swapped tuple that may equal a listed word. For n=3 the all-zero-factor maximum needs the convention 0 if absent. Sorting a four-word representative as a<d≤b<c gives n=7+4x+3y+2z+t with all four parameters nonnegative, proving the generating series and first fiber. Palindromes give S_n, partitioning the words gives the remaining counts, and the pole at 1 of order four yields n³/144 and the limiting fraction 1/6; other poles have order at most two.
residual_risks: The finite author checker was inspected, not executed; it corroborates rather than proves the unrestricted theorem.
The Finding's ‘if and only if’ cannot be read as excluding an already listed word represented by a swapped tuple in a degenerate case.

value.rationale: As mathematics, a full inverse-image classification for the joint binary window extrema at weight three identifies exactly when reversal is not the only ambiguity, supplies the sharp smallest example, and shows that ambiguity persists at positive limiting prevalence. It addresses a natural reconstruction boundary, not just a one-off finite check. This value judgment does not supply distinct content beyond the indexed equivalent.
residual_risks: The classification is not a reconstruction result for higher weights or for other observations.
